rows.en:
(Phew~, classes are over for today,
and tomorrow's a day off!)

(Tomorrow, at least, I'll forget about studying
and have as much fun as I can.)

Tomorrow's a day off, but of course you'll spend
it studying all day, right, \p?
Huh?! O-of course, Pinon-chan...

A-anyway, more importantly,
what are you planning to do, Pinon-chan?

Hmm, I feel like you just changed the subject...
Well, fine.

Tomorrow I'm thinking of staying home
and reading a book.

Huh~, you do seem like a book lover, Pinon-chan.
What kind of book are you going to read?

I could explain it to you, but I'm not sure
you'd be able to understand...
You read books that hard, huh.
To put it simply...
...and that's what the book is about.
O-oh~, I see...
(I didn't understand a single thing...)

Haah~, I explained it simply so even you
could understand, but it seems it was no use.
Sorry... Pinon-sensei...

(I almost forget sometimes, but
Pinon-chan really is a genius...)

(Phew~, classes are over for today,
and tomorrow's a day off!)
Huh?! O-of course, Pinon-chan...

Huh~, you do seem like a book lover, Pinon-chan.
What kind of book are you going to read?
You read books that hard, huh.
(I didn't understand a single thing...)

(I almost forget sometimes, but
Pinon-chan really is a genius...)

(Next class is Hilda-sensei's P.E., huh.
I wonder what we'll be doing today?)
Haah~...

What's wrong, sighing like that?
Pinon-chan?
I'm dreading the next P.E. class...

(Pinon-chan has neither stamina
nor athletic ability, after all...)
rows.notes: Shared m/f (the female line keeps the same Japanese).

rows.en: It might be tough, but let's do our best!

I do want to do my best, but
my body just can't keep up...
Then make up for it with guts, Pinon-chan!
I see... Guts, huh!

All right! Then I'll show you my guts!
Follow me, \p!!

Huff, huff, huff...
I'm worn out... It seems this is as far as I go......
(Just from running out to the field?!)
(I guess guts weren't going to cut it after all...)

(Next class is Hilda-sensei's P.E., huh.
I wonder what we'll be doing today?)
Then make up for it with guts, Pinon-chan!
(I guess guts weren't going to cut it after all...)
(Now then, what should I buy today?)

(Hm? Isn't that Pinon-chan?
Looks like she's arguing with the shop clerk...)
What's wrong, Pinon-chan?

That clerk is the one at fault!
Saying, "For you, a children's size
might be better..."
(I think the clerk has a point, though...)
Hmph! Are you saying you agree with the clerk?!

N-no, I think you'd have no problem at all
with adult sizes, Pinon-chan...
Naturally! Honestly, that clerk...

(Pinon-chan really hates being treated
like a kid, huh.)
(Now then, what should I buy today?)

(Hm? Isn't that Pinon-chan?
Looks like she's arguing with the shop clerk...)

(Pinon-chan really hates being treated
like a kid, huh.)

(Pool class on a hot day like this
really is the best.)

(Hm? Pinon-chan...
What's she staring at so seriously?)
Haaah~~~...

Staring at Nanase and the others so enviously...
What's up, Pinon-chan?
N-nothing!
Give me a few more years, and I'll...!
rows.notes: Muttered; she is envying the older girls' figures in swimsuits.
